version: Score rules version. Stamped on every report so older screens stay comparable.
persona: Configurable value (persona). Change it here instead of in code.
persona.name: What the bot calls itself.
persona.tone: How the bot should sound. Used when on-device phrasing is available.
persona.useAcknowledgements: Say a short thanks before the next question.
persona.acknowledgements: Short phrases rotated between questions. One per line in settings.
persona.systemPrompt: Instructions for the optional on-device model. The guided script is used if the model is unavailable.
interview: Configurable value (interview). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.durationLimitSeconds: How long a screen may last, in seconds. 300 is five minutes.
interview.capMode: Hard stops at the limit. Soft finishes the current thought and allows the grace period.
interview.graceSeconds: Extra seconds after the limit when the cap is soft.
interview.openingGreeting: First thing the bot says. Use {name}, {bot}, {role}, {company}, {minutes}, and {warmup}.
interview.closingMessage: Said when the screen finishes normally. Use {name}.
interview.partialClosingMessage: Said when the screen ends early. Use {name}.
interview.hardStopMessage: Said when a hard cap cuts the screen off. Use {name}.
interview.timeWarningSeconds: When to show the "time is almost up" note, in seconds left.
interview.timeWarningMessage: The note shown when time is almost up.
interview.warmupCount: How many opening questions to ask before your mandatory questions. Two is the usual.
interview.warmupQuestions: Opening questions, asked before your mandatory questions.
interview.languages: Languages the candidate can be interviewed in. The selected voice language should be one of these.
interview.allowTyping: Let the candidate type an answer if speech recognition fails.
interview.candidateQuestions: Configurable value (interview.candidateQuestions). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.candidateQuestions.allowed: Leave time for the candidate to ask something.
interview.candidateQuestions.maxSeconds: How much time to keep for the candidate's own question.
interview.candidateQuestions.prompt: How the bot invites their question.
interview.candidateQuestions.reply: What the bot says back. It should not invent an offer.
interview.followUp: Configurable value (interview.followUp). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.followUp.maxCount: How many follow-up questions to ask when an answer is very short.
interview.followUp.depth: Light, medium, or deep. This picks the follow-up wording.
interview.followUp.tone: A note about the follow-up style, for you and for the optional on-device model.
interview.followUp.thinAnswerWordThresho: Answers shorter than this many words can get a follow-up.
interview.followUp.prompts: Configurable value (interview.followUp.prompts). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.followUp.prompts.light: Configurable value (interview.followUp.prompts.light). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.followUp.prompts.medium: Configurable value (interview.followUp.prompts.medium). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.followUp.prompts.deep: Configurable value (interview.followUp.prompts.deep). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.followUp.appliesTo: Which parts of the screen may get a follow-up. Mandatory questions are usually left out so the answer stays verbatim.
interview.followUp.logisticsPrompt: Asked if pay, notice, or location was missing. Use {missing}.
interview.flow: Configurable value (interview.flow). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.flow.tailoredMax: How many CV-specific questions to ask after your mandatory questions, if time allows.
interview.flow.probesMax: How many deeper skill questions to ask if time allows.
interview.flow.askLogistics: Ask years, pay, notice period, and location.
interview.flow.skipLogisticsWhenSecondsL: Skip the practical question when fewer than this many seconds remain.
interview.flow.skipTailoredWhenSecondsLe: Skip CV-specific questions when fewer than this many seconds remain.
interview.flow.skipProbesWhenSecondsLeft: Skip deeper questions when fewer than this many seconds remain.
interview.flow.skipCandidateQuestionsWhe: Skip the candidate's question when fewer than this many seconds remain.
interview.probeTopics: Deeper questions by skill. Use * as the fallback. Match is a skill name.
interview.questionTemplates: Configurable value (interview.questionTemplates). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.questionTemplates.matchedSkill: Configurable value (interview.questionTemplates.matchedSkill). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.questionTemplates.secondSkill: Configurable value (interview.questionTemplates.secondSkill). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.questionTemplates.missingSkill: Configurable value (interview.questionTemplates.missingSkill). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.questionTemplates.impact: Configurable value (interview.questionTemplates.impact). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.questionTemplates.genericImpac: Configurable value (interview.questionTemplates.genericImpact). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.questionTemplates.probe: Configurable value (interview.questionTemplates.probe). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.voice: Configurable value (interview.voice). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.voice.preferredNames: Browser voice names to try, in order.
interview.voice.lang: Language passed to speech recognition and the browser voice.
interview.voice.rate: Speech rate. 1 is normal. Slightly under 1 sounds calmer.
interview.voice.engine: browser uses the free built-in voice.
interview.voice.mixIntoRecording: Try to include the bot in the recording. Browsers cannot capture the built-in voice directly.
interview.silence: Configurable value (interview.silence). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.silence.commitSilenceMs: How long to wait after the candidate stops talking before taking the answer.
interview.silence.maxListenMs: Stop listening after this many milliseconds and ask them to continue.
interview.silence.maxRetries: How many times to ask again when nothing was heard.
interview.silence.retryPrompts: What to say when nothing was heard.
interview.silence.noSpeechPrompt: Shown when the microphone stays quiet.
interview.asr: Configurable value (interview.asr). Change it here instead of in code.
interview.asr.lowConfidenceThreshold: Below this confidence (0 to 1), a line is flagged for a person to check. A score of 0 is treated as unknown, not low.
interview.asr.treatZeroConfidenceAsUnkno: Chrome often reports 0 when it has no confidence value. Leave this on so those lines are not flagged.
interview.asr.ignoreConfidenceForScoring: Do not lower the communication score because recognition was unsure. Accents are not a penalty.
interview.asr.flagForReview: Mark unsure lines for a person to read.
interview.asr.repromptOnLowConfidence: Ask the candidate to repeat a line only because recognition was unsure. Off by default.
interview.asr.whisperModel: Free on-device model used only if they choose offline transcription.
interview.asr.offerOfflineTranscription: Show the offline transcription button when the browser has no speech recognition.
mandatoryQuestions: Questions every candidate is asked, after the opening questions and before anything else.
scoring: Configurable value (scoring). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.weights: Configurable value (scoring.weights). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.weights.communication: Relative weight for communication. Recognition confidence is not part of this.
scoring.weights.mandatoryQuestions: Relative weight for your mandatory questions.
scoring.thresholds: Configurable value (scoring.thresholds). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.thresholds.shortlistMin: Score needed for Shortlist, if there is no blocking issue.
scoring.thresholds.maybeMin: Score needed for Maybe. Below this is Reject.
scoring.stars: Configurable value (scoring.stars). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.stars.2: Minimum score for 2 stars. Below this is 1 star.
scoring.fitment: Configurable value (scoring.fitment). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.fitment.ctcOverBudgetRatio: Expected pay above budget times this number is a red flag. 1.15 means 15% over.
scoring.fitment.noticePeriodGoodDays: Notice at or under this many days scores full marks.
scoring.fitment.noticePeriodMaxDays: Notice longer than this is a poor fit.
scoring.fitment.minYearsSlack: Years within this many of the minimum still score well.
scoring.fitment.substantiveWordCount: Configurable value (scoring.fitment.substantiveWordCount). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.fitment.mandatoryMinWords: Configurable value (scoring.fitment.mandatoryMinWords). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.fitment.communicationTargetWords: Configurable value (scoring.fitment.communicationTargetWords). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.fitment.unknownExperienceScore: Configurable value (scoring.fitment.unknownExperienceScore). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.fitment.unknownNoticeScore: Configurable value (scoring.fitment.unknownNoticeScore). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.fitment.unknownCtcScore: Configurable value (scoring.fitment.unknownCtcScore). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.fitment.partialMinCoverage: If fewer than this fraction of your questions were answered, the recommendation stays Partial.
scoring.cv: Configurable value (scoring.cv). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.cv.shortlistScore: CV match needed before someone is marked as a CV shortlist.
scoring.cv.minSkillCoverage: Configurable value (scoring.cv.minSkillCoverage). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.cv.weights: Configurable value (scoring.cv.weights). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.cv.weights.skills: Configurable value (scoring.cv.weights.skills). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.cv.weights.experience: Configurable value (scoring.cv.weights.experience). Change it here instead of in code.

scoring.cv.emptyKeywordPoints: Configurable value (scoring.cv.emptyKeywordPoints). Change it here instead of in code.

scoring.redFlags.enableCtcOverBudget: Configurable value (scoring.redFlags.enableCtcOverBudget). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.redFlags.enableLongNotice: Configurable value (scoring.redFlags.enableLongNotice). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.redFlags.enableLowCommunication: Configurable value (scoring.redFlags.enableLowCommunication). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.redFlags.enableMissingMandatory: Configurable value (scoring.redFlags.enableMissingMandatory). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.redFlags.lowCommunicationBelow: Configurable value (scoring.redFlags.lowCommunicationBelow). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.redFlags.blockShortlistOnMajor: Configurable value (scoring.redFlags.blockShortlistOnMajor). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.strongSkills: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.strongSkills). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.weakSkills: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.weakSkills). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.experienceOk: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.experienceOk). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.experienceLow: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.experienceLow). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.experienceUnknow: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.experienceUnknown). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.payOk: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.payOk). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.payHigh: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.payHigh). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.payUnknown: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.payUnknown). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.noticeOk: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.noticeOk). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.noticeLong: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.noticeLong). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.noticeUnknown: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.noticeUnknown). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.communicationStr: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.communicationStrong). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.communicationThi: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.communicationThin). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.mandatoryGood: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.mandatoryGood). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.mandatoryMissed: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.mandatoryMissed). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.reasonTemplates.partial: Configurable value (scoring.reasonTemplates.partial). Change it here instead of in code.

scoring.redFlagTemplates.payHigh: Configurable value (scoring.redFlagTemplates.payHigh). Change it here instead of in code.
scoring.redFlagTemplates.noticeLong: Configurable value (scoring.redFlagTemplates.noticeLong). Change it here instead of in code.

recommendations: Configurable value (recommendations). Change it here instead of in code.
recommendations.shortlist: Configurable value (recommendations.shortlist). Change it here instead of in code.
recommendations.shortlist.label: Word used for a strong recommendation.
recommendations.shortlist.summary: Configurable value (recommendations.shortlist.summary). Change it here instead of in code.
recommendations.maybe: Configurable value (recommendations.maybe). Change it here instead of in code.
recommendations.maybe.label: Word used for a mixed recommendation.
recommendations.maybe.summary: Configurable value (recommendations.maybe.summary). Change it here instead of in code.
recommendations.reject: Configurable value (recommendations.reject). Change it here instead of in code.
recommendations.reject.label: Word used when they do not meet the bar.
recommendations.reject.summary: Configurable value (recommendations.reject.summary). Change it here instead of in code.
recommendations.partial: Configurable value (recommendations.partial). Change it here instead of in code.
recommendations.partial.label: Word used when the screen ended early and too little was covered.
recommendations.partial.summary: Configurable value (recommendations.partial.summary). Change it here instead of in code.
pdf: Configurable value (pdf). Change it here instead of in code.
pdf.logoDataUrl: Optional logo as a data URL. Leave empty for none.
pdf.partialBanner: Banner on reports that ended early.
pdf.notProvidedText: Shown when a field was never answered.
pdf.showRubricVersion: Configurable value (pdf.showRubricVersion). Change it here instead of in code.
pdf.showTranscriptAppendix: Configurable value (pdf.showTranscriptAppendix). Change it here instead of in code.
pdf.maxTranscriptChars: Long transcripts are cut here so the PDF still builds.
pdf.truncationNote: Configurable value (pdf.truncationNote). Change it here instead of in code.
notifications: Configurable value (notifications). Change it here instead of in code.
notifications.inDashboard: Show an alert on the candidate list when a screen is ready.
notifications.dashboardAlertTitle: Configurable value (notifications.dashboardAlertTitle). Change it here instead of in code.
notifications.mailto: Recruiter email. Used only to open a draft. Nothing is sent automatically.
notifications.emailjs: Configurable value (notifications.emailjs). Change it here instead of in code.
notifications.emailjs.enabled: Turn on EmailJS. The free tier sends a short note, not the video.
notifications.webhookUrl: Optional address that receives the result JSON. Leave empty to disable.
notifications.webhookIncludeTranscript: Include the transcript in the webhook. The video is never included.
privacy: Configurable value (privacy). Change it here instead of in code.
privacy.retentionDays: Delete screens older than this many days from this browser.
privacy.autoPurge: Delete old screens automatically when you open the app.
privacy.abandonMinutes: If someone leaves and does not return within this many minutes, make a partial report.
privacy.consentBody: Consent text the candidate must read.
recording: Configurable value (recording). Change it here instead of in code.
recording.enabled: Record camera and microphone during the screen.
recording.requireCamera: If on, they cannot start without a camera. Leave off so a failed camera does not trap them.
recording.allowContinueWithoutCamera: Offer to continue without video if the camera is blocked.
recording.videoBitsPerSecond: Video bitrate. Lower keeps files smaller. 280000 is about 10 MB for five minutes.
recording.width: Configurable value (recording.width). Change it here instead of in code.
recording.height: Configurable value (recording.height). Change it here instead of in code.
recording.frameRate: Configurable value (recording.frameRate). Change it here instead of in code.
recording.mimePreference: Recording formats to try, in order. Safari often needs video/mp4.
recording.timesliceMs: Configurable value (recording.timesliceMs). Change it here instead of in code.
recording.captionOnVideo: Write the current line onto the video.
recording.mixBotVoice: Mix microphone audio, and bot audio when a mixable voice is available, into the file.
recording.hint: Shown next to the camera request.
dashboard: Configurable value (dashboard). Change it here instead of in code.
dashboard.pageSize: How many people to show on one page.
dashboard.defaultFilter: Starting filter on the candidate list.
dashboard.showCvScoreWhenUnscreened: Configurable value (dashboard.showCvScoreWhenUnscreened). Change it here instead of in code.
links: Configurable value (links). Change it here instead of in code.
links.codeLength: Length of the readable short code.
links.shareMessage: Text used for WhatsApp, email, and the share button. Use {name}, {role}, {minutes}.
storage: Configurable value (storage). Change it here instead of in code.
storage.googleDrive: Configurable value (storage.googleDrive). Change it here instead of in code.
storage.googleDrive.enabled: Show the Google Drive upload button.
storage.googleDrive.clientId: Free Google OAuth client id. Leave empty to hide Drive upload.
storage.googleDrive.folderName: Name used for the uploaded file group.
llm: Configurable value (llm). Change it here instead of in code.
llm.enabled: Allow the free in-browser model to rephrase questions.
llm.autoStart: Start loading the model when an interview opens. The screen never waits for it.
llm.modelId: WebLLM model id. Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC is the default.
llm.fallbackModelId: A smaller model tried if the first one fails. Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-q4f16_1-MLC is the default.
llm.timeoutMs: How long to wait for a rephrase before using the script.
llm.temperature: Configurable value (llm.temperature). Change it here instead of in code.
llm.maxTokens: Configurable value (llm.maxTokens). Change it here instead of in code.
roleForm: Configurable value (roleForm). Change it here instead of in code.
roleForm.currencies: Configurable value (roleForm.currencies). Change it here instead of in code.
roleForm.defaultCurrency: Currency selected on a new role.
roleForm.defaultMinYears: Configurable value (roleForm.defaultMinYears). Change it here instead of in code.
roleForm.titlePlaceholder: Configurable value (roleForm.titlePlaceholder). Change it here instead of in code.
roleForm.skillsPlaceholder: Configurable value (roleForm.skillsPlaceholder). Change it here instead of in code.
